page: Microsoft Azure EC8es_v6 is an ECEV6 family memory-optimized virtual machine instance. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture with an Intel processor, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external block storage, though the instance is designated as Premium Storage capable. There are zero integrated GPUs, and it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the EC8es_v6 provides a high memory-to-vCPU density, making it suitable for memory-bound workloads that do not require local scratch space. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities. Appropriate workloads include relational databases, in-memory caching layers, and enterprise applications requiring substantial memory footprints relative to compute cores.
